About Me

Agriculture meets content.

Practical knowledge from the field, translated into simple content people can actually use.

I'm Darsh, an Agronomist and Horticulturist with hands-on experience in plantation, landscape management, plant nutrition, pest management and horticultural planning.

Through @darshagroconsultant, I create educational content around gardening, landscaping, plants, agriculture and better ways to manage green spaces.

My goal is simple: make professional horticulture easier to understand and easier to implement.
